description: Force-stop an in-progress backtest by ID, or a whole batch in one call with experimentId (a parameter experiment) or backtestIds. Queued backtests are cancelled before they start.

backtestIds.description: Stop several backtests in one call (for example every run of a sweep started one by one). Queued ones are cancelled before they start; finished ones are left as they are.

experimentId.description: Stop a whole parameter experiment in one call: every one of its backtests that is still queued or running. Use the experimentId start_parameter_experiment returned.

name: stop_backtest
title: Stop a backtest
